capabilities: Review changed files and push the current file, selected files, or all changes
Edit the commit message and choose the target branch before pushing
Show pushed and unpushed status markers on files and folders in the file explorer
Set up a Git remote from inside Obsidian, initializing a repository if needed
extras: Desktop-only; Obsidian mobile cannot run local Git. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It does not fetch, merge, delete branches, or resolve conflicts.
problem: Committing and pushing vault changes with Git normally means leaving Obsidian and working in a terminal.

relations.evidence: Create an empty repository on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, Forgejo, or any normal Git host.

requires.name: Git hosting account (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, Forgejo, etc.)

summary: Git client that reviews changed files, edits commit messages, and pushes to a Git remote from inside Obsidian without a terminal.
